judge_rules.rubric: Score all criteria 0..points from the full output and visible input. Reference wording is not an answer key.
judge_rules.alternatives: Accept evidence-supported alternate reasoning, equivalent formulas and appropriate different priorities.
judge_rules.critical_errors: Apply rubric-specific deductions and caps. Contradictory legal triggers or unsupported scientific claims cannot receive full credit.
judge_rules.grader: A separately executed host model/reviewer reads every candidate anew and supplies criterion score, reason and concrete evidence. Request digest binds assessment to actual bytes; no reference whitelist.
